text.p: The Manila Electric Co (Meralco), the country's biggest electricity distributor, said on Wednesday that its net income in 1996 rose by 14.8 percent at 5.064 billion pesos as against 4.411 billion the previous year.
In an audited report, the company said its earnings per share rose to 9.24 pesos last year from 7.71 pesos in 1995.
Operating revenues of the company climbed 21.6 percent at 57.086 billion pesos from 46.952 billion the previous year, the report said.
Meralco's kilowatt-hour (kwh) sales rose 12.2 percent for the year to 17.81 billion kwhs from 15.876 billion. The company earlier projected an eight to ten percent sales growth for the year.
Meralco said the operating expenses of the power distributor also increased by 22.9 percent to 52.56 billion pesos from 42.78 billion.
Operating income edged higher by 8.5 percent from 4.172 billion pesos in 1995 to 4.526 billion, Meralco said.
Total assets of the company in 1996 was 62.056 billion pesos, 23.1 percent higher as against 50.426 billion in 1995.
As of end-1996, Meralco's customers numbered 2.87 million compared to 2.66 million in 1995, the company said.
